Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert prematurely concluded that the Ensembl genome browser link [https://www.ensembl.org/Delphinapterus_leucas/Info/Index](https://www.ensembl.org/Delphinapterus_leucas/Info/Index) was the correct source for the most recent GFF3 file as of October 20, 2020, without verifying the update history or confirming the recency of the file. This oversight directly contradicts the task requirement to ensure the file's date aligns with the specified date, leading to an incomplete and potentially inaccurate solution.
